verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair question for a government digital-administration service, since such services can publish developer APIs and SDKs, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a JavaScript shell behind account login and a Cloudflare challenge on the ministry site. Nothing in the pack mentions an official SDK, API or developer program for ANEF.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
